card.name: Words leading into mineral supplements
card.fires_on: Linking words or commas just before a mineral such as iron, calcium or magnesium is named, in lists of supplements, antacids and foods that interfere with absorption of a drug.

modes.label: Before supplement names
modes.description: Words like containing, or, and dietary right before iron, calcium or mineral supplements.
modes.example: oral supplements containing iron<< or>> calcium, or buffered medications.

modes.label: Commas in interacting-product lists
modes.description: Commas inside lists of foods, antacids and supplements that bind a drug.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word mineral or minerals next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name a mineral supplement like iron or calcium in a drug interaction list.
